text: The United States and Iran publicly confirmed completion of an agreement ending military operations. A formal signing ceremony was scheduled, and the U.S. announced removal of the naval blockade alongside reopening procedures for the Strait of Hormuz. Multiple governments publicly recognized or supported the agreement framework. Military operations were replaced by an implementation and verification phase.

meta.note: Formal signing remained pending, but participating parties publicly acknowledged a completed settlement framework.

text: Oil prices declined while equity index futures and major Asian equity markets advanced following confirmation of a completed U.S.-Iran agreement framework and planned reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Market pricing shifted toward renewed maritime transit and commodity flow. Capital moves across energy and equity markets in response to the anticipated restoration of access through existing trade routes.

meta.note: The repricing reflects expectations tied to announced implementation measures rather than completed physical restoration of transit.
